 DelFest 2027 Returns to Maryland: Tickets Go on Sale November 18
 One of Maryland’s most beloved music festivals is returning for another unforgettable Memorial Day weekend! DelFest 2027 will take place May 27–30, 2027, at the Allegany County Fairgrounds in Cumberland, Maryland, bringing four days of live music, community, and celebration to Western Maryland.
 This year’s festival promises to be particularly special as organizers celebrate bluegrass legend Del McCoury’s 88th birthday with a “Delebration,” featuring artists who have helped make DelFest a Memorial Day weekend tradition.
 With more acts to come here is the current lineup: The Del McCoury Band, The Travelin’ McCourys, Sierra Ferrell, The California Honeydrops, Leftover Salmon, Maggie Rose, Dan Tyminski Band, Yonder Mountain String Band, Keller & The Keels, Dogs in a Pile, Steep Canyon Rangers, Davisson Brothers Band featuring Billy Contreras, JigJam, Junior Sisk & Ramblers Choice, Joe Craven. 
 DelFest 2027 Tickets Go on Sale November 18
 Mark your calendars! Full festival tickets for DelFest 2027 go on sale Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 12:00 PM EST. 
 Fans planning to attend this popular Maryland music festival can visit the official DelFest website for ticket information and purchasing details.
 Get Tickets: DelFest Official Website 
 A Special Celebration for Del McCoury
 DelFest 2027 will celebrate Del McCoury’s 88th birthday with a special “Delebration,” bringing together many of the musicians who have contributed to the festival’s history and success.
 Known for its welcoming atmosphere and celebration of bluegrass and roots music, DelFest has become a favorite Memorial Day weekend destination for music lovers from Maryland, Washington, DC, Virginia, and beyond.
 More Artists Will Be Announced
 The excitement doesn’t stop with the initial festival announcement. Organizers have confirmed that additional artists will be announced in the coming months , giving fans even more to look forward to as DelFest 2027 approaches.
 Keep an eye on the official festival website for lineup additions, ticket updates, and other announcements.
 DelFest 2027 Event Details
 Event: DelFest 2027
 Dates: May 27–30, 2027
 Location: Allegany County Fairgrounds
 City: Cumberland, Maryland
 Ticket On-Sale Date: Wednesday, November 18, 2026
 Ticket On-Sale Time: 12:00 PM EST
 Website: www.delfest.com 
 Plan Your Memorial Day Weekend in Maryland
 Whether you’re a longtime DelFest attendee or considering your first visit, the 2027 festival offers an opportunity to experience four days of live music in the scenic mountains of Western Maryland.
 With a special celebration honoring Del McCoury and more artist announcements on the way, DelFest 2027 is shaping up to be a memorable addition to Maryland’s festival calendar.
